From the test, `locs` is asserted to have length 89 and `FixedLocator` is constructed with `nbins=12`. In `FixedLocator.__init__`, `self.nbins = max(nbins, 2)` so it stays 12. In `tick_values`, since `self.nbins` is not `None`, it computes

`step = max(int(np.ceil(len(self.locs) / self.nbins)), 1)`.

Substituting the test values gives `step = max(int(ceil(89 / 12)), 1) = max(int(ceil(7.416...)), 1) = 8`.

The loop is `for i in range(1, step):`, so with `step = 8` it iterates over `i = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7`, which is 7 iterations. Line 1804 is the first statement in that loop body, so it executes once per iteration, i.e. 7 times.
